verdict.rationale: Aircall documents a shared inbox where every conversation is visible and teammates can collaborate in real time and step in. That directly supports multiple teammates working from shared conversations, but presence, assignment and internal threads are not documented as product features. The activity-tracker and do-not-disturb items are developer tutorials, so they are building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented shared-number setup, native agent presence/availability indicators, conversation assignment, internal comment threads, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, several teammates share one number with presence, conversation assignment, and internal threads

citations.quote: A shared inbox keeps every conversation visible, giving your team the ability to collaborate in real time and step in without losing context.
Calls, SMS, and messaging live in one platform
